entries.name: ASC39 oral tablets
entries.stage: Preclinical oral amylin programme; planned IND not verified
entries.summary: Ascletis describes ASC39 as a once-daily oral small-molecule selective amylin receptor agonist. Its 3 August 2026 portfolio update reports only animal findings and listed a US IND filing for the third quarter of 2026; no accessible official source reviewed on 10 October confirmed that filing or a human study.
entries.ukAuthorisation: The reviewed sponsor evidence does not establish UK marketing authorisation or UK clinical-trial authorisation for ASC39.
entries.nhsEngland: No NICE recommendation or NHS England access is established by the reviewed evidence.
entries.supply: Preclinical development and a planned US filing do not establish lawful UK retail supply, pharmacy stock or sale by Shift Some Timber.
entries.limitations: The reported weight observations are from diet-induced-obesity rats, not people. They do not establish human efficacy, safety, tolerability, dose, durability, muscle preservation or superiority. A planned third-quarter IND filing is not presented as submitted, cleared or as trial initiation; the absence of a later accessible announcement is retained as uncertainty.
